_comment: Tailor's Loom recipes. Tier-unlocked light mage armor, hoods, cowls, and bags crafted from spider silk and magical reagents.

recipes.name: Leather Cap
recipes.description: Craft a lightweight protective cap from cured wolf pelts.

recipes.name: Silk Cowl
recipes.description: Weave lightweight spider silk into a protective cowl with leather trimming.

recipes.name: Silk Robe
recipes.description: Weave a dense vestment of spider silk backed by supple wolf hide.

recipes.name: Padded Tunic
recipes.description: Craft a lightweight padded tunic from wolf pelts reinforced with wood battening.

recipes.name: Ingredient Bag
recipes.description: Craft an ingredient bag providing 15 kg of weight exemption for culinary ingredients.

recipes.name: Frostweave Hood
recipes.description: Weave arctic wolf pelts and spectral ectoplasm into an enchanted light hood.

recipes.name: Frostweave Robe
recipes.description: Tailor a light robe infused with ghostly ectoplasm and glacial essence.

recipes.name: Boneguard Cap
recipes.description: Reinforced with splints of hardened crypt bone for resilient head protection.

recipes.name: Spidersilk Vestment
recipes.description: A dense weave of abyssal spider silk that absorbs crushing deep-sea impacts.

recipes.name: Rimewalker Hood
recipes.description: A cowl woven with glacial essence to protect against bone-chilling cavern winds.

recipes.name: Apprentice's Hood
recipes.description: Weave an apprentice's hood from spider silk to expand magical focus.

recipes.name: Apprentice's Robe
recipes.description: Weave a simple lightweight robe from spider silk to enhance mana and energy focus.

recipes.name: Voidweave Hood
recipes.description: Infuse subterranean spider silk and pelt with planar void essence to shape a resilient cowl.

recipes.name: Voidweave Robe
recipes.description: Weave a dense vestment of spider silk and void essence for superior spell power and energy flow.
